name: Bunker Hill Covered Bridge
facts: Bunker Hill Covered Bridge, built in 1895 by Andrew Loretz Ramsour, showcases the rare Haupt truss design, possibly the last wooden Haupt truss bridge in the United States.
After its 91‑foot span opened in 1895, the bridge received its iconic roof in 1900, and a tin roof replaced the original shingles in 1921, preserving its historic charm.
In 2001, the American Society of Civil Engineers honored Bunker Hill Covered Bridge as a National Historic Civil Engineering Landmark, cementing its place on the National Register of Historic Places.
